SELECT 
  o.OrderID,
  o.OrderDate,
  cust.CompanyName,
  ROUND(SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)), 2) as order_value,
  ROUND(SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)) / 29787.38, 2) as multiple_of_avg
FROM Orders o
JOIN "Order Details" od ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID
JOIN Customers cust ON o.CustomerID = cust.CustomerID
WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', o.OrderDate) = '2023-09'
GROUP BY o.OrderID, o.OrderDate, cust.CompanyName
HAVING SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)) > (29787.38 * 3)
ORDER BY order_value DESC

SELECT 
  p.ProductID,
  p.ProductName,
  c.CategoryName,
  SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m', o.OrderDate) = '2023-09' THEN od.Quantity ELSE 0 END) as sept_units,
  SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m', o.OrderDate) = '2023-08' THEN od.Quantity ELSE 0 END) as aug_units,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m', o.OrderDate) = '2023-09' THEN od.Quantity ELSE 0 END) / 
    NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m', o.OrderDate) = '2023-08' THEN od.Quantity ELSE 0 END), 0), 2) as growth_multiple
FROM Products p
JOIN "Order Details" od ON p.ProductID = od.ProductID
JOIN Orders o ON od.OrderID = o.OrderID
JOIN Categories c ON p.CategoryID = c.CategoryID
WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', o.OrderDate) IN ('2023-08', '2023-09')

ORDER BY growth_multiple DESC

SELECT 
  cust.CustomerID,
  cust.CompanyName,
  cust.Country,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m', o.OrderDate) = '2023-08' THEN o.OrderID END) as aug_orders,

## EXECUTIVE NARRATIVE

September 2023 demonstrated solid overall performance with 7.64% revenue growth and 10% customer acquisition growth, driven by increased order volume and market expansion. However, this positive headline masks critical geographic challenges that demand immediate attention. While emerging markets in Austria, Venezuela, and Brazil are delivering exceptional growth (200%+ revenue increases), traditional core markets are deteriorating significantly—the USA, our largest market by volume, contracted 40% in orders and 34% in revenue, while France experienced a catastrophic 61% revenue decline. Additionally, 10 customers who were active in August have churned in September, with three high-value accounts (Berglunds snabbköp, LILA-Supermercado, and Victuailles en stock) representing particular risk. The company's top product, Côte de Blaye, continues to drive 13% of total revenue, and the Beverages category remains the strongest performer at 21.5% of total sales. To sustain growth momentum, immediate action is required: (1) urgent investigation and recovery efforts in USA and France markets to prevent further deterioration, (2) proactive customer retention outreach to the 10 at-risk accounts, and (3) strategic investment in high-growth emerging markets to capitalize on the 200%+ growth opportunities. Without intervention in declining markets, the positive emerging market growth will be insufficient to offset losses in established territories.
